title: FP8 forward: E4M3 Q/K/V, descale, FP8 quantization of P, and error

steps.title: FP8 Q·Kᵀ (kind::f8f6f4), descale folded into scale, S written to the probe
P scaled by 2⁸ and quantized to E4M3, written back to TMEM; FP8 P·V (TS); the epilogue undoes the scaling
Error analysis: normalize O by the quantized Σp̂

cases.name: n1
cases.purpose: N=1: all 128 rows of tile 1 are out of bounds (TMA fills zeros, store skips them); O = v_descale·V₈, LSE = scale·q_descale·k_descale·q₈·k₈.

cases.name: one_block
cases.purpose: N=128: only tile 0 is valid, B>1, H>1: coordinates of the 8-bit tensor map (UINT8, box row = D bytes) and the grid mapping.

cases.name: two_tiles
cases.purpose: N=256 one tile pair, two blocks, D=128: tile 1's Q coordinate, the TMEM columns of S¹/O¹, the 32-column location of P¹.

cases.name: tile1_tail
cases.purpose: N=200: tile 1 has only 72 valid rows; the second block has only 72 valid keys (the FP8 that TMA fills with zeros is +0).

cases.name: tile1_position
cases.purpose: D=128, N=190: V[j]=j/N exposes the byte order of P (4 keys per column, key 4c in the lowest byte).

cases.name: short_tail
cases.purpose: N=37, D=128: one 128-byte row is exactly one 128B swizzle row; the 91 padding keys must be masked.

cases.name: scale
cases.purpose: scale=1, logits in the hundreds: both descales must be folded into the softmax scale; without subtracting the max it overflows.

cases.name: uniform
cases.purpose: Q=0, D=64: every P is 2⁸ = 256 (exactly representable in E4M3), O is the mean of V, LSE = ln N: the P scaling must be undone consistently in ℓ and LSE.

cases.name: ones_v
cases.purpose: V=1: O = Σp̂/ℓ. Step 2 (ℓ uses the FP32 p) has an error of about 1e-2; step 3 (ℓ uses the quantized p̂) gives O exactly 1.

cases.name: ones_v_exact
cases.purpose: Checked only in step 3: with Σp̂ normalization O is an exact convex combination, so for V=1 O must be exactly 1 (tolerance 1e-5). Step 2's ℓ=Σp has an error of about 1e-2 here.

cases.name: position
cases.purpose: V[j]=j/N, D=64, 5 blocks: the 64B swizzle V descriptor (SBO=512) and the K/V ring indices.

cases.name: peaked
cases.purpose: D=128, 7 blocks, large logits: P is concentrated on a few keys, so the E4M3 relative error (≤ 2⁻⁴) goes straight into O: one of the cases with the largest error.

cases.name: peaked_d64
cases.purpose: D=64, N=513: the 64B swizzle Q/K descriptors (each K slice advances 32 bytes, SBO=512).

cases.name: ring
cases.purpose: 12 blocks, 24 ring items: the ring buffer wraps many times (the FP8 ring has 8 stages).

cases.name: medium
cases.purpose: Medium-size random data, D=128.

cases.name: medium_d64
cases.purpose: Medium-size random data, D=64.

cases.name: causal_n1
cases.purpose: Causal and N=1: the only query sees only itself.

cases.name: causal_pair
cases.purpose: Causal, one tile pair, large logits: block 2 of tile 0 is fully masked (P all 0, must not produce NaN).

cases.name: causal_tail
cases.purpose: Causal and N not a multiple of the block size: the diagonal mask and the tail mask apply at the same time.

cases.name: causal_n_bound
cases.purpose: Causal, N=640: the block count of the last tile pair is set by N (5 blocks), not by the diagonal.

cases.name: causal_position
cases.purpose: Causal, V[j]=j/N, D=128: a mask or P byte order that is off by one reads the value of another position.

cases.name: causal_peaked
cases.purpose: Causal and large logits: masked elements must not take part in the max; the first few rows have very few keys, so the quantization error of P is largest there.

cases.name: causal_uniform
cases.purpose: Causal and Q=0: O[i] is the mean of V[0..i], LSE[i] = ln(i+1).

cases.name: causal_ones_v
cases.purpose: Causal and V=1: row 0 has only one key (P̂ = 256).

cases.name: causal_ones_v_exact
cases.purpose: Checked only in step 3: with Σp̂ normalization O is an exact convex combination, so for V=1 O must be exactly 1 (tolerance 1e-5). Step 2's ℓ=Σp has an error of about 1e-2 here.

cases.name: causal_medium
cases.purpose: Medium-size causal, D=128.

cases.name: causal_medium_d64
cases.purpose: Medium-size causal, D=64.

cases.name: long_tail
cases.purpose: One hot key with logit≈8 per head, the rest ≈0: about N·e⁻⁸ of the probability mass sits in a long tail of p≈e⁻⁸, and the mean of V is not 0. Without scaling P by 2⁸ the long tail falls into the E4M3 subnormal range and O is wrong; with 2⁸ it is correct (lesson §3.4).

cases.name: causal_long_tail
cases.purpose: Same as above, causal, D=64: later rows have longer tails.

cases.name: perf
cases.purpose: B·H=64, N=4096, D=128: the same shape as lab 40, in FP8.

cases.name: perf_causal
cases.purpose: Same as above but causal.

cases.name: perf_d64
cases.purpose: D=64: the MMA is only a small share, and softmax (MUFU) is even more the bottleneck.

cases.name: perf_8k
cases.purpose: N=8192, D=128: the main loop dominates.
